top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a single identifiable invention (the magic-wavelength lattice) that has been reproduced and surpassed in Sr, Yb and Hg systems and compared across continents, so it rests on clues from nature rather than on theory. Katori for the idea and Ye for taking it to the 10^-18 level gives a two-name allocation that matches the record, and the citation is limited to what has been demonstrated. An award is preferable to no award.
